# Auditious — Knowledge Hub

> Auditious is a compliance automation platform — the fastest path to SOC 2, ISO 27001, and continuous compliance. This site is the Auditious Knowledge Hub: guides, playbooks, and expert insights on security frameworks, evidence automation, and audit readiness, written for founders, security engineers, and GRC teams.

The Knowledge Hub is built on Payload CMS + Next.js and served from https://auditious.io. Articles live under `/blogs`, are grouped by category (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, Evidence Automation, Continuous Compliance), and each post includes structured data (Article, Breadcrumb, FAQ); product, pricing, and comparison pages live on the same domain. The `/admin` path is the Payload CMS admin panel and is not intended for indexing or crawling.

## Knowledge Hub

- [Blog — Auditious Knowledge Hub](https://auditious.io/blogs): Main listing of guides and playbooks on SOC 2, ISO 27001, evidence automation, and continuous compliance.
- [Search](https://auditious.io/search): Full-text search across every published article.

## SOC 2 Guides

- [What is SOC 2?](https://auditious.io/soc/what-is-soc-2): Introduction to the SOC 2 framework and Trust Services Criteria.
- [SOC 2 Type I vs Type II](https://auditious.io/soc/type-i-vs-type-ii): How the two report types differ and which one you need.
- [SOC 2 Checklist](https://auditious.io/soc/soc-2-checklist): Step-by-step readiness checklist for an audit.
- [SOC 1 vs SOC 2 vs SOC 3](https://auditious.io/soc/soc-1-vs-soc-2-vs-soc-3): How the SOC report families compare.

## Product

- [Evidence Automation](https://auditious.io/product/evidence-automation): Automatically collect and map audit evidence.
- [Auditor Portal](https://auditious.io/product/auditor-portal): Shared workspace for auditors and audit prep.
- [Risk Management](https://auditious.io/product/risk-management): Track, assess, and remediate risk.
- [Integrations](https://auditious.io/product/integrations): Connect your cloud, HR, and identity stack.
